````text
# PR #3179: Patch: patches ship refused to promote the pending patches

Closes #3178

`cargo jackioh` compiles again, so the `patches ship` step no longer dies at the build. I didn't run `patches ship`, so I haven't seen it promote the fragments. It rewrites `patches.json`, `shipped.json`, `CATALOG_VERSION` and the pending fragments, and the harness would deliver that. `patches check` passes.

## What was wrong

The failure was in the tool, not in a fragment. #3145 (dead-code audit #3121) deleted `RunNodeKind::is_boss()` from `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. #3165 (`run-sim`) merged afterwards with a call to it at `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs:503`. The two PRs didn't conflict in text, so each looked fine alone. Together they broke the `jackioh-tools` build on `main`, and `patches ship` can't run if `cargo jackioh` doesn't build. I didn't see the failed run's log. I took this compile error from the plan and confirmed that `is_boss` has no definition left.

## The change

One line, in `tally`:

```rust
if matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss) {
```

This is the body of the removed `is_boss`. I checked it with `git show fb42f52ced`. `RunNodeKind` was already imported in the file. The loop body is unchanged.

## Tests

- `cargo fmt --check` passed.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` finished clean.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools run_sim` ran 4 tests, all passed, and 1 daily test was skipped by its own `#[ignore]`. One of the four is `the_tally_counts_each_kind_and_prints_a_dash_for_none`. It feeds a `MiniBoss` row and asserts `boss_hp[0] == (22, 1)`, so a `matches!` that dropped `MiniBoss` would fail it. I added no new test.
- `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools` succeeded.
- `cargo jackioh patches check` passed, and so did `cargo jackioh catalog check`.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passed: "1721 rulings, 4196 proofs … ok".
- `grep -rn "\.is_boss()" crates apps/web/src` finds nothing.
- `git status` shows only `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` modified. The three fragments in `crates/cards/patches/pending/` are untouched.

I did not run the full workspace tests or the web tests. The harness runs those after I stop.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Inline the `matches!` instead of restoring `is_boss` in `jackioh-run`.** Restoring it would undo #3145's audit decision and change a pure crate's public API for one caller. #3145 already inlined the same `matches!` in `crates/run/src/tests.rs`.
- **No pending fragment and no ruling.** `crates/tools/src/*.rs` is classified `Internal`, so `classify --claims` asks for nothing. `patches check` refuses a fragment that claims nothing. No rule is decided, so there is no ruling to write.

## For a reviewer

- **Someone has to start the ship by hand.** `patches-ship.yml` starts on pushes that touch `crates/cards/patches/pending/**` or `patches.json`, and this change touches neither. A person must run Actions → patches ship → Run workflow after this merges. Otherwise the next merged fragment ships all three together. The bot can't do this, since it can't edit `.github/` or reach GitHub.
- **Why CI let this through.** Two PRs were each green, and `main` went red with nothing stopping the second one. I did not look into whether the merge queue or `scripts/ci-scope.sh` should have caught it.

I used no subagents. I followed the plan with no departures.

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |

| 1 | build, 7.8 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 6s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 2s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 134s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1442s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 414s |

````text
# #3178: patches ship refused to promote the pending patches
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

`cargo jackioh patches ship` refused on main at 79927460d50f3e56f13c8833e8e239abe717dcd4 ([the run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42019282788)), so no pending patch shipped and `CATALOG_VERSION` did not move (R646, R1280000).

The run's `ship` step names the refusal. Fix the fragment or the tool on a branch whose `cargo jackioh patches check` passes; once it merges, run this workflow again (Actions -> patches ship -> Run workflow) if it touched nothing under `crates/cards/patches/pending/`.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42022183327)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Make `cargo jackioh` compile again, so `cargo jackioh patches ship` can promote the three pending fragments. I ran it, and the cause is not a fragment or the ship logic. On `main` at 79927460 `jackioh-tools` fails with E0599: `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs:503` calls `RunNodeKind::is_boss()`, which no longer exists. #3145 (dead-code audit #3121) deleted that method from `crates/run/src/lib.rs`, and #3165 (`run-sim`) merged later with a call to it. I did not see the failed run's log; this is the only compile failure on `main`, and it is enough to fail the `ship` step.

With one line changed in a scratch clone (so this worktree stays clean), these all pass:
- `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools`
- `patches check`
- `patches ship`, which shipped v0.5.11q, v0.5.11r and v0.5.11s and exited 0
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools the_tally`

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` | change | In `tally` (line 503), replace `fight.kind.is_boss()` with `matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss \| RunNodeKind::Boss)`. `RunNodeKind` is already imported on line 42. |

Do not touch:
- `crates/run/**`
- `crates/cards/patches/**`, including `pending/`. The three fragments must stay as they are; `patches ship` consumes them.
- `crates/server/.env.example` and any other `CATALOG_VERSION` site. Only `patches ship` bumps these.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
- `spec/`.

Governing text: R646, R1280000 and R1366000 describe `patches ship` and need no change. CLAUDE.md rule 4 keeps `crates/run` pure, which is why its API is left alone. No new ruling is needed because no rule is decided.

## Steps

1. Open `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`, function `tally`, inside `for fight in &outcome.fights`. Change this line:
   ```rust
            if fight.kind.is_boss() {
   ```
   to:
   ```rust
            if matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss) {
   ```
   Keep the body unchanged: the `boss_hp` update and `bosses += 1`. The new line is 80 columns, and `cargo fmt --check` accepted it in the scratch clone.
2. Make no other edit. Do not re-add `is_boss` to `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. I rejected that because it undoes #3145's audit decision and changes the pure crate's public API for a single caller. #3145 also inlined the same `matches!` in `crates/run/src/tests.rs`, so this follows what the repo already does.
3. Add no pending fragment. `classify::area` files `crates/tools/src/*.rs` under `Internal`, so `cargo jackioh classify --claims` asks for nothing. A fragment claiming nothing is refused by `patches check` ("claims nothing…").

## Tests

No new test. The existing `run_sim::tests::the_tally_counts_each_kind_and_prints_a_dash_for_none` in `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` covers the changed line. It feeds a `MiniBoss` row and asserts `sums.boss_hp[0] == (22, 1)` and `sums.boss_hp[1] == (0, 0)`. A `matches!` that dropped `MiniBoss` would fail it. Before the fix the whole `jackioh-tools` test binary fails to compile.

Commands to run:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools the_tally`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools run_sim`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh patches check`
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`

Do not run `cargo jackioh patches ship` in the worktree. It rewrites `patches.json`, `shipped.json`, `CATALOG_VERSION` and the pending fragments, and the harness would deliver that. `ship` is the workflow's job.

## Done when

- [ ] `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` no longer calls `is_boss`, and `grep -rn "\.is_boss()" crates apps/web/src` finds nothing.
- [ ] `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools` succeeds, so `cargo jackioh patches check` runs and passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools run_sim` passes.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The diff is that one line only. `crates/cards/patches/pending/` still holds its three fragments, and `git status` shows no other file.

## Risks

- **A semantic merge conflict, not a rules or replay problem.** Nothing in the engine, cards, AI, wire format or replay hashing changes, so determinism and hidden information are untouched.
- **Other hidden breakage.** The scratch run covered `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `patches ship` with this one change, and both passed. If the builder's run turns up another error, it is new since 79927460; report it rather than widening the change.
- **Version bump.** The ship will produce v0.5.11q, r and s, all micros: the 4-card `plays` fragment is far below `PATCH_MIN_CARDS` (50), and the other two claim only `visual`. `CATALOG_VERSION` in `crates/server/.env.example` becomes v0.5.11s.

## Open questions

- **Someone has to run the ship after this merges.** `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` triggers on pushes to `main` that touch `crates/cards/patches/pending/**` or `patches.json`. This fix touches neither, so the workflow will not start by itself. A person must run Actions → patches ship → Run workflow, or the next merged fragment will ship all of them together. The bot cannot start it because it cannot edit `.github/` or reach GitHub.
- **Why CI let this through.** Two PRs conflicted in meaning without conflicting in text, and `main` went red with no check stopping the second one. Whether the merge queue or `scripts/ci-scope.sh` should have caught it is a question for a person. This plan does not change CI.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
